statement: The SUID rate is higher among infants whose mothers experienced severe mental health issues during pregnancy compared to those who did not.
rationale: This design uses the case series (ncfrp_v51) for numerator and population reference sources (prams_p8_arf, prams_p7_arf) to determine maternal mental health issues during pregnancy. The denominator source (cdc_natl15) provides necessary live birth denominators.
prior_art: The closest tested work is bedsharing_ms_v7.C11, which explores the association between bed-sharing and SUID incidence but does not address severe mental health issues during pregnancy.
required_concepts: severe mental health issues during pregnancy
cannot_establish: This design cannot establish causation or account for potential temporal trends and changes in reporting practices over time.
